products.title: ProudPants Waterproof Seat Liner
products.body_html:
Potty training does not stop when you leave the house. The stroller, the car seat and the high chair are exactly where a small accident is hardest to deal with, because you cannot just throw them in the wash. The ProudPants Seat Liner sits between your child and the seat, catches the small stuff, and goes in the washing machine instead of the upholstery.

It pairs naturally with ProudPants: your child still feels the moment they go, and the seat underneath stays dry while you get to a bathroom.

Four Layers, One Job

  • Top: soft quilted towel fabric that takes liquid in quickly and feels comfortable against bare legs.
  • Middle: an absorbent cotton layer that holds a small accident.
  • Barrier: a waterproof TPU layer that stops liquid from reaching the seat.
  • Bottom: silicone dots that grip the seat, so the liner stays in place when your child wriggles.

Fits What Your Child Sits In

  • Strollers, car seats and high chairs with a standard 5-point harness.
  • A round opening in the lower middle (about 6 cm across) lets the crotch buckle pass straight through, so the harness is used exactly as before.
  • Snap buttons on the sides hold the liner around the seat and let it fold flat for the diaper bag.

Size And Details

  • About 38 x 40 cm (15 x 15.7 in)
  • Weight about 156 g, light enough to keep in the bag every day
  • Polyester fiber with a TPU waterproof layer
  • Seven colors: Light Gray, Beige, Dark Gray, Navy, Black, Mint Green and Sky Blue

Care

Machine wash or hand wash, then hang to dry. Skip fabric softener, which coats the towel fabric and slows down how fast it absorbs. Rinse after an accident and it is ready to use again.

A Note On Car Seats

Many car seat makers advise against placing anything under a child that was not tested with that seat. Please check your car seat manual before using any seat liner, and always make sure the harness is fastened snugly.

products.title: ProudPants™ Potty Training Underwear
products.body_html:
Still Treats Their Pull-Up Like a Diaper? That's Not Them. That's The Pull-Up.

Modern pull-ups are engineered to feel almost dry no matter how much a child goes. Great for laundry, hard on learning. Over the same decades that absorbency improved, the average age of potty training moved from roughly 28 months a generation ago to closer to 37 months today, and researchers studying the shift point to that dryness as one of the reasons. If your child treats a pull-up like just another diaper, they are responding exactly the way the product was designed to make them respond.

Feel First: The Wet-Signal™ 4-Layer Design

ProudPants is built around a four-layer crotch panel. Against the skin sit six layers of soft cotton gauze, thin enough that your child feels the wet straight away. Behind that, a terry cloth core soaks up a small accident, and a waterproof layer keeps it off their clothes. The printed pure-cotton outer layer keeps them looking and feeling like real underwear, not a diaper. They are built to hold a small accident, not a full bladder, and that is deliberate. The feeling is the lesson, and every child moves at their own pace.

What Is Inside The Panel

  • Layer 1, against the skin: six layers of soft cotton gauze, so wetness is felt immediately
  • Layer 2: absorbent terry cloth core that holds a small accident
  • Layer 3: waterproof layer that keeps a small accident off their clothes
  • Layer 4, outside: printed pure cotton, so they look and feel like real underwear

Built For Every Kid, Every Pace

  • Feels wet straight away, just like real underwear
  • Terry cloth core and a waterproof layer hold a small accident
  • Machine washable and reusable, wear after wear
  • Sized for real kids: 2T, 3T and 4T, mapped to actual weight ranges rather than guesswork
  • Works for strong-willed, older and sensory-sensitive trainers, not only the easy cases

Find Their Perfect Fit

  • 2T fits 17 to 22 lbs (7.5 to 10 kg)
  • 3T fits 20 to 31 lbs (9 to 14 kg)
  • 4T fits 29 to 37 lbs (13 to 17 kg)

The soft elastic stretches about two inches for a snug, comfortable fit. If your child falls between two sizes, go with the larger one.

How To Care For Them

Wash once before the first wear. Machine wash cold or warm with like colours, then tumble dry low or hang to dry. Skip fabric softener and dryer sheets. They coat the gauze and the terry core and cut down how much the panel can absorb, which is the one job you need it to do. No bleach, and no ironing on the crotch panel. Full care instructions here.

What's Included

  • The 5-Day Potty Training Jumpstart, our free guide, with every order
  • Free shipping
  • 60-day money-back guarantee. If you don't see real progress, send it back for a full refund

ProudPants comes in 5-Pack, 10-Pack and 15-Pack, in 2T, 3T and 4T. Pick the size that fits your child today and the pack that fits how you train.
